identity: An Abu Dhabi driving-theory practice test, translated into Arabic from an English original — 20 four-option multiple-choice items, one per layout line, on motorway and school-bus speed limits, following distances, hydroplaning, tyre tread depth, seat belts, fog, blind spots, load distribution and bus lanes. Latin 'm' survives at @196/199/202/205 and decimal points are stripped ('0 5 ملم' = 0.5 mm, '0 62' = 0.62).
law: §S in its purest form, 20 items × [stem ‖ opt ‖ opt ‖ opt ‖ opt] = 100 boundaries over 501 tokens (5.0 tokens/segment). Two structural facts do all the work. (1) The stem runs to the last token the four options SHARE syntactically — which in this test is very often a bare preposition left dangling: 'محدودة ب' @30، 'عبر' @125، 'كل' @170، 'فإنك' @214، 'يشير إلى' @413، 'أيضا ل' @490، 'عليك تفادي' @350. Nothing inside a stem cuts, however long: the fronted adverbials 'خلال المطر وفي حال وجود خطورة الانزلاق' (item 3), 'عند الضباب' (14), 'عند تحميل المركبة بحمولة ثقيلة' (16), 'عندما تكون حالة الطرق والحالة الجوية جيدة' (19) and the conditional 'إذا كانت سيارتك مجهزة بالوسائد الهوائية' (9) are all stem interior (S1). (2) An option is one segment however many tokens it holds — ten in item 9, five in items 4/12/16 — and however many و it contains (S2): 'وزن الشحن والراكبين والعدة الإضافية' is ONE option.
reasoning:
The batch-12 shared-prefix refinement (doc_87ac286b6785: 'يصنع الصابون من زيت ‖ الزيتون ‖') is the rule I had to apply with care, because it cuts BOTH ways in this document and the discriminator is how many times the prefix is printed.
- Printed ONCE → it is stem. That is what 'محدودة ب' and 'أيضا ل' and 'كل' are: a shared head printed a single time, with only the contrasting tails as options.
- Printed ONCE PER OPTION → it belongs to each option. Item 6 repeats 'السير بسرعة أقل من' four times, so each eight-token phrase is a full option and the stem stops at 'عبر' @125. Item 17 repeats 'وزن' four times, so the stem stops at 'إلى' @413. Item 12 repeats nothing and simply splits at the four verbal nouns. This is the same test I ran on doc_c4cb5672fc6c and it gave the opposite answer there for the four '7 شباط عام YYYY' options — a prefix repeated per option is never factored out.
Numbers: A2 forbids cutting inside digits, so '0 5 ملم' (@111-113), '1 5 ملم' (@116-118), '0 62' (@284-285) and the other stripped decimals are each ONE option, not two. Item 5's option set reads 2 / 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 mm, which confirms the pairing.
Item 8 ('24 m د 33 m د 36 m د 27 m د'): the 'د' recurs uniformly AFTER each number, four times for four options, so it is a unit-marker belonging to the option it follows, not an option letter prefixing the next one. Reading it as a prefix would leave a stray trailing 'د' and five option slots for four answers. Boundaries at @197 @200 @203 @206, and @206 is the pre-<NL> token, which the second reading would fail to explain.
Items 14, 18 and 20 each carry the catch-all 'جميع ما ذكر'. Recovered entry 7 (doc_5ec52c5c5c0b: 'لا شيء مما ذكر صحيح' is ONE option, not two) applies directly — three tokens, one segment, no cut at 'جميع' or 'ما'.
Every one of the 19 pre-<NL> tokens plus the final token @500 falls out of the option structure automatically, which is the check that my option counts are right: if any item had been mis-split, its last option would not have landed on the pre-<NL> token.
